fields.description: Set once the case exists. A file uploaded from the wizard carries `draft` instead, and is re-pointed here when the draft is submitted.

fields.description: Which item on the supporting-documents checklist this file satisfies, where one applies.

fields.description: Set when an officer uploaded the file.
fields.label: Uploaded By (Officer)

fields.description: Set when the submitter uploaded the file. Exactly one of the two uploader fields is always populated.
fields.label: Uploaded By (Submitter)

fields.description: Storage key for the object. Blobs are never held in the database.
fields.label: File URL

fields.description: Sniffed server-side, never taken from the client. A renamed .exe is still an .exe.
fields.label: MIME Type

fields.description: Content hash. Deduplicates re-uploads of the same photo across a case, and proves an evidence file has not been swapped since it was filed.
fields.label: SHA-256

fields.description: Nothing is served to an officer until this reads Clean. A public intake system accepts arbitrary files from the internet and then hands them to government staff to open.
fields.label: Scan Status

fields.label: Scan Detail
